That platform includes an append-only ledger, a grant gate, payment-rail integration, a charity pipeline, three user experiences, a partner API, tenancy and KMS. The workload also includes recurring regulatory change: tax-year changes, Nacha rule changes, PostgreSQL major upgrades gated on Strata support (CNV-ARC-004) and expand/contract migrations per tenant (CNV-ARC-005). Adding these hours has a large effect at zero customers. The engineering residual is now 289 h (headline.csv L,0). At 1,200 h of maintenance it becomes 689 h, all contracted. At 1,500 h it becomes 989 h, which is above hire_threshold_hours 800 (Engine.staffRole), so one engineer is employed before the first customer.
